div.head: Af 2
div.ab: III. Gif hwa þæra mynsterhama hwylcne gesece for hwylcere scylde, þe cyninges feorm to belimpe, oþþe oðerne freonne hyred þe arwyrde sy, age he ðreora nihta fyrst him to gebeorganne, butan he þingian wille.

III. Gif hwa þara mynsterháma hwelcne for hwelcere scylde gesece, þe cyninges feorm to belimpe, oððe oðerne frione hiered þe árwyrðe sie, age he þreora nihta fierst him to gebeorganne, buton he ðingian wille.

Si quis ad ecclesie mansionem pro quacumque culpa confugiat, que ad firmam regis pertineat uel alteri commodo deseruiat et uenialis sit, habeat tres noctes terminum cauendi sibi, nisi reconciliari quesierit.

{III} Gif hwa þara mynsterhama hwelcne for hwelcere scylde gesece, þe cyninges feorme to belimpe, oððe oðerne frione hiered þe árwyrðe sie, age he þreora nihta fierst him to gebeorganne, buton he ðingian wille.

If someone for whatever offense should seek out some sanctuary that is supported by the king’s render or another free and honorable [religious] househould, let him have a three-night time period to protect himself [therein], unless he wishes to settle.

If a man flees, for any manner of offence, to any monastery which is entitled to receive the king's food-rent, or to any other free community which is endowed, for the space of three days he shall have right of asylum, unless he is willing to come to terms [with his enemy].

If anyone for any guilt flees to any one of the monastic houses to which the king’s food-rent belongs, or to some other privileged community which is worthy of honour, he is to have a respite of three days to protect himself, unless he wishes to be reconciled.

Wenn jemand wegen irgend welcher Schuld eines der Stiftshäuser aufsucht, welchem Königs-Beköstigung zukommt, oder einen anderen immunen Convent, welcher von Ehrenrang ist, so habe er dreier Nächte Frist, sich [dort] zu bergen, ausser wenn er [mit dem Verfolger] sich vergleichen will.

If someone, on account of any offence whatever, seeks one of the minster-houses to which the king’s food-rent belongs, or another immune community which is of honourable rank, let him have three nights’ respite to shelter himself [there], unless he wishes to come to terms [with his pursuer].
